summary: Iteration 6: targeted frontend retest of the two LOW issues from iteration 5. The script is /app/tests/iter6_retest.py and all 33 checks passed. (1) Logout from a protected page: at 1920x800 (header) and 390x844 (via the sheet), the demo customer from /account and astro1 from /studio all land on '/', and /api/auth/me returns 401 afterwards. (2) Touch targets at 390: account tabs (5) are 44px. Studio tabs (7) are 44px. Slot chips (6) are 44px minimum. astro-lang (11) and astro-exp (9) chips are 44px minimum. The sheet Close button is 44x44. The sheet logout-button is 44px. The legal links (4) are 44px. brand-logo is 44px. (3) Regression at 390 and 1920: scrollWidth equals the viewport width on /, /discover, /astrologers/{id}, /legal/terms, /account and /studio. Every account and studio tab switches to active and shows a non-empty panel. There were no page errors. At 390 the studio tab list wraps cleanly onto 3 rows.
critical_code_review_comments: Logout now calls nav('/', {replace:true}) before awaiting logout(), which fixes the Protected redirect race. The chips use min-h-11 sm:min-h-0 and the sheet Close is h-11 w-11. Both are correct.
